purpose: Track locally available SEIS development and AI-assistant tools without storing credentials, claiming live provider access, or changing the single-writer policy.

tools.name: Codex
tools.observedState: Active supervised repository writer for this SEIS task.
limitations: Does not push, merge, deploy, rotate secrets, or run SSH without explicit approval.
Must preserve unrelated user and agent work in the dirty worktree.
safetyNotes: Never commit credentials or private vault material.
Treat secondary assistant output as candidate evidence until verified.
tools.seisUsage: Primary implementation and validation owner for the current change package.
tools.publicPrivateRisk: Public-safe when prompts, reports, and diffs exclude secrets and private data.

tools.name: Xcode
tools.observedState: Xcode 26.6 welcome window shows the recent SEIS Swift Package at packages/seis_platform_swift.
limitations: Xcode presence is not build evidence.
Opening the package does not prove signing, simulator, or app runtime readiness.
Repository edits through Xcode must respect the single-writer handoff.
safetyNotes: Do not add meaningless Swift files for language statistics.
Do not store provider keys, SSH keys, tokens, or private vault material in Xcode project files.
Run SwiftPM checks before claiming native validation.
tools.seisUsage: Apple-first native development surface for SeisPlatformKit and SeisAppleNativeShell.
tools.publicPrivateRisk: Public-safe as local tooling metadata; not a live integration or credential surface.

tools.name: Claude Code CLI
tools.observedState: Claude Code CLI 2.1.195 is installed at ~/.local/bin/claude; claude auth status reports loggedIn true through local claude.ai auth and a sanitized smoke returned CLAUDE_OK.
limitations: Local Claude auth is user-session state outside the repository, not an API-key credential committed to SEIS.
No Claude output is accepted as repository truth until Codex verifies it against files and checks.
Repository writes remain disabled unless a human explicitly transfers writer role.
safetyNotes: Do not paste provider keys, tokens, private vault notes, SSH material, or personal sensitive data into Claude.
Use sanitized prompts and diff-only review packets.
Record Claude output as candidate review material, not final evidence.
tools.seisUsage: Secondary review surface for scoped architecture, refactor, and product-language critique after Codex prepares sanitized context.
tools.publicPrivateRisk: Public-safe as a local OAuth-backed review route when context excludes secrets and private material.

Use Gemini for sanitized research and review only.

Keep patch sessions small and reversible.

handoffRules: Codex remains the only writer unless a human explicitly transfers writer role.
Xcode may be used to inspect and run the Swift package, but native claims require SwiftPM or Xcode build evidence.
Claude and Hermes are available through local user auth/config as bounded helper or review routes, not autonomous writers.
Gemini, Kimi, OpenAI, Aider, Goose, Cursor, and LM Studio are connected through SEIS as bounded helper or review routes, not autonomous writers.
Hermes may receive only sanitized context through local user configuration.
No tool may receive provider keys, SSH private keys, tokens, private Obsidian notes, or real host credentials.
API keys, desktop app state, local model caches, provider sessions, and chat logs stay outside the repository.
Secondary tool output remains candidate evidence until Codex verifies it against repository state.
